# GenericOverlap

Module: **core** · directory: `src/Programs` · binary: `src/Programs/GenericOverlap`

Manual: [GenericOverlap (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/GenericOverlap.md)

```text
GenericOverlap, version 0.01

Usage: GenericOverlap [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --states : names of the vector files obtained using exact diagonalization (multiple arguments)
    --state-list : provide the names of the vector using a single column formatted text file
    --states-matrix : use a series of vectors stored as c
    -c, --complex : Assume vectors consist of complex numbers
    -s, --scalar-product : Get the scalar product, not the overlap
    -p, --polar : print complex numbers in polar coordinates
    --conjugate : Conjugate the second (complex) number
    --discard-sign : compute sum_i |v1_i * v2_i| instead of sum_i v1_i * v2_i
    -x, --no-cross : calculate only overlap of 1st vector with all others
    -t, --threshold : apply threshold and display only those overlaps exceeding this value (default value = 0)
    --sum : sum all computed overlaps
    --no-square : calculate only the scalar products
    -n, --normalize : normalize vectors before calculating any overlaps
    -d, --dimension : show vector dimension
    --quiet : discard any output except the overlaps
    --matrix : export the overlap as a binary matrix

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
